def fft_real_transform(data, stride, n):
    c_data = (c_double * len(data))(*data)
    c_stride = c_int(stride)
    c_n = c_int(n)
    result = (c_double * len(data))()

        self.real = ctypes.c_double(real)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f\"{self.real.value} + {self.imag.value}*1j\"

class MatrixComplex:
    def __init__(self, data=None):
        if data is None:
            self.data = np.empty((2, 3), dtype=np.complex128)
        else:
            self.data = data

        self.shape = (2, 3)

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        return MatrixComplex(self.data[index])

    def __setitem__(self, index, value):
        self.data[index] = value.data.flatten()

            self.data = np.empty((3,), dtype=np.complex128)
        else:

        return VectorComplex(self.data[index])

import ctypes

gsl = ctypes.CDLL(\"/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so\")

class SplineInterpolation:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = np.array(x, dtype=np.double)
        self.y = np.array(y, dtype=np.double)

    def interpolate(self):
        # Initialize GSL objects
        g_x = gsl.libgsl.gsl_vector_view.array=self.x
        g_y = gsl.libgsl.gsl_vector_view.array=self.y

        g_x_stride = len(self.x)
        g_y_stride = len(self.y)

        c_cubic_spline = gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_alloc(gsl.libgsl.gsl_interp_cs, self.x.size)
        c_akima_spline = gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_alloc(gsl.libgsl.gsl_interp_akima, self.x.size)
        c_steffen_spline = gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_alloc(gsl.libgsl.gsl_interp_steffen, self.x.size)

        # Set data for cubic spline interpolation
        gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_init(c_cubic_spline, g_x, g_y, 0, self.x.size)
        # Set data for Akima spline interpolation
        gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_init(c_akima_spline, g_x, g_y, 0, self.x.size)
        # Set data for Steffen spline interpolation
        gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_init(c_steffen_spline, g_x, g_y, 0, self.x.size)

        min_x = np.min(self.x)
        max_x = np.max(self.x)

        interpolated_results = []

        for i in range(101):
            xi = (max_x - min_x) * i / 100 + min_x
            yi_cubic = gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_evaluate(c_cubic_spline, xi).real
            yi_akima = gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_evaluate(c_akima_spline, xi).real
            yi_steffen = gsl.libgsl.gsl_spline_evaluate(c_steffen_spline, xi).real

            interpolated_results.append((xi, yi_cubic, yi_akima, yi_steffen))

        return interpolated_results


def interpolate_splines(x, y):
    interpolation_instance = SplineInterpolation(x, y)
    return interpolation_instance.interpolate()
